name: Limbal Ring Enhancement
description: Enhances the dark ring around the edge of the iris (the limbal ring) to a vivid, defined border. In unmodified humans, a prominent limbal ring is a marker of youth, health, and perceived attractiveness — studies have consistently shown that people with visible limbal rings are rated as more attractive. The modification permanently produces a crisp, dark limbal ring regardless of age. It's the subtlest eye modification available — many people who have it are never identified as modified. Combined with prismatic iris resequencing, the result is eyes with vivid color surrounded by a sharp dark border that makes the color pop. The modification is so subtle and universally flattering that some clinics include it as a default add-on to any eye-related geneware installation.
source_organism: Synthetic melanin concentration factors (no organism source)
manufacturer: Widespread — bundled with most eye modifications
procedure: Topical retroviral eye drops, self-administered, single application
side_effects: Essentially none — the modification is too minor to produce significant side effects
Rare: limbal ring pigment slightly uneven in budget applications
social_perception: So common and subtle that it's barely considered a modification. Many people don't realize they have it — it was bundled with another procedure. It's the genetic equivalent of getting your teeth whitened.
story_hooks: A forensic analyst identifies a suspect by the specific limbal ring pattern produced by a particular clinic's gene stock — even the subtlest modification leaves a traceable signature

A Tier 5 executive's carefully natural appearance is revealed as extensively modified when a medical scan shows their limbal rings are gene-enhanced — in a culture where 'natural' is a luxury signal, the revelation is socially devastating
